packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/objc-receipt-clang/version and components/objc-reference-clang/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest; .github/workflows/pins-bot.yml writes components/objc-receipt-clang/linux-sha256 on the bump's branch, verified against the new release's SHA256SUMS. components/objc-reference-clang has no linux-sha256, by design, and needs none.
prBodyNotes: The pins bot commits the new release's Linux archive digest to components/objc-receipt-clang/linux-sha256 on this branch; the build runs again on that commit. An objc-receipt-clang bump must also pass tests/objc/objc-source-inventory-host-test.sh on Linux and a Mac.
